A3.note: Reaction laws stay in reactions.aqueous; the parameter document excludes them.

conventions.mass: molar_mass is copied unchanged from the Engine parameter document, including rounded magnitudes, units and provenance. Formula masses for conservation are derived by the column; no Engine mass is altered.
conventions.caloric: inputs/caloric.json is the single source of ideal-gas calorics. Ionic standard thermochemistry is completed by Engine from the four K(T) laws and the aqueous neutral reference; there is no independent reaction enthalpy or second absorption-heat source.
conventions.reaction_direction: K is dimensionless; correlation is natural ln K: a and c dimensionless, b in K, d in 1/K, reference_temperature and temperature limits in K; reference_pressure_pa in Pa. Negative stoichiometric coefficients are reactants; positive coefficients are products. Extent unit: mol of reaction as written. Enthalpy follows the declared K(T) law and its source_basis/standard_state_id, with Engine reference conversion; it is not an independently fitted heat.
conventions.neutral_reference: eq.NeutralReference fields: solvent (component ID), solute_molality_ratios (dimensionless), standard_molality_mol_per_kg (mol/kg solvent), species_reference (eq.SpeciesReference enum). No per-species override is declared (empty mapping); Engine uses PureLiquid for solvent and InfiniteDilution for every solute. Enum names: PureLiquid, InfiniteDilution, PureGas; no PureGas choice is used.
conventions.assessment: Regions are prepared-row minima/maxima, not continuous validity domains. For saturation-capped heat observations, region records requested loading caps; evaluated_region records available native endpoint loadings from the retained results. wt_percent is unloaded aqueous analytical amine mass percent using unchanged Engine molar masses; loading is mol CO2/mol analytical MDEA. AARD_percent uses available nonzero observations only and is not experimental uncertainty. Phase search covers only the retained 751 endpoint states. Native observation values are retained by row; derivative actions were not assessed by #228.
